bone.note: Warm shafts with a shadow deep enough to read around joints.

rib.note: Light costal arches in front of the weathered vertebrae.

spine.note: Separate vertebrae and posterior processes from the ribs.

ilium.note: Bright flared pelvic wings above the dark girdle.

socket.note: Deep eye bowls, nasal aperture and tooth separation.

eyes.note: Enlarge the ember in each recess to survive pixel sampling.

teeth.note: Sampled ivory in the maxilla and mandible.

rag.note: Sampled dark red cloth on separated strips.

fold.note: Shadowed torn panels behind the legs.

hide.note: Sling, hilt, shield back and ankle wraps.

bronze.note: Buckle, boss rivets and crossguard in rubbed bronze.

iron.note: Oxidised bands, pauldron and shield rim.

oxide.note: Broad reddish corrosion patches on the pauldron.

blue.note: Lift the blue on the outward face away from the grey rim.

device.note: A worn ochre trefoil above the shield boss.

blade.note: Matte steel body of the pitted blade.

edge.note: Bright bevel separating the sword from the bones.

blade rust.note: Broken islands of rust inside the steel silhouette.
